subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth

term is related to the third term.

SWEET : WSETE :: SALTY : ASLYT :: DRINK : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

SWEET : WSETE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59e1cb2a7420f45d0d606147e7b90b50fa972e058ca5c5252c777d9a4c77e8db.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/191ce1308b6ab0e66022a7771aaeba3d39b4ae37b4af3df96f13149a40668bb4.png] 

And,

SALTY : ASLYT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24511ac4319037add3e420a2b23c79997d84aed6f04404794a75f224f75d900d.png] 

Similarly,

DRINK : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9882623f2c642e2d5646dc59778d3b85e8d9faca61c446a3a44539b9910ad27.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
